at_least_five_manifestations_present.assessment: The patient has fever ≥5 days, bilateral conjunctival congestion, oral changes, polymorphous exanthema (rash), and extremity changes; fulfills at least five clinical manifestations.
at_least_five_manifestations_present.evidence: fever for the past week ... erythematous rash ... strawberry red tongue, red and cracked lips ... swollen red hands ... whites of both eyes are red

fever_duration_value_recorded_now_in_day.assessment: The history states 'persistent fever for the past week'; 'week' is interpreted as 7 days.
fever_duration_value_recorded_now_in_day.evidence: persistent fever for the past week

manifestation_1_present.assessment: Fever has persisted for 7 days, which meets the duration criterion.
manifestation_1_present.evidence: persistent fever for the past week

manifestation_2_present.assessment: Redness of both eyes without discharge indicates bilateral conjunctival congestion.
manifestation_2_present.evidence: whites of both eyes are red with no discharge

manifestation_3_present.assessment: Strawberry tongue and red, cracked lips are changes of the lips/oral cavity.
manifestation_3_present.evidence: strawberry red tongue, red and cracked lips

manifestation_4_present.assessment: Presence of erythematous rash on the trunk is a polymorphous exanthema.
manifestation_4_present.evidence: erythematous rash on the girl's trunk

manifestation_5_present.assessment: Swollen, red hands represent peripheral extremity changes.

manifestation_6_present.assessment: There is no mention of cervical lymphadenopathy in the vignette; default to NULL per prescreen doctrine.

manifestations_count.assessment: The patient exhibits persistent fever, rash, strawberry tongue, red/cracked lips, swollen red hands, and bilateral conjunctival congestion—meeting at least five specified manifestations.
manifestations_count.evidence: persistent fever for the past week; erythematous rash on the girl's trunk; strawberry red tongue, red and cracked lips; swollen red hands; whites of both eyes are red with no discharge

__THRESH__::manifestations_count::ge::5.assessment: The patient has at least five of the specified clinical manifestations, meeting the threshold.
__THRESH__::manifestations_count::ge::5.evidence: persistent fever for the past week; erythematous rash; strawberry tongue; red/cracked lips; swollen red hands; bilateral conjunctival congestion

patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_febrile_m.assessment: The constellation of findings (fever, oral changes, extremity changes, rash, conjunctival congestion) supports presence of acute Kawasaki disease state.
patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_febrile_m.evidence: persistent fever for the past week; strawberry red tongue, red and cracked lips; swollen red hands; erythematous rash; bilateral conjunctival congestion

patient_has_finding_of_cervical_lymphade.assessment: There is no mention of cervical lymphadenopathy; chart is silent so defer to visit.
No mention of acute cervical lymphadenopathy; chart is silent so defer to visit.
No mention of nonpurulent cervical lymphadenopathy; chart is silent so defer to visit.

patient_has_finding_of_congestion_of_thr.assessment: The chart mentions strawberry tongue, red/cracked lips, but does not specifically describe congestion of throat or pharyngeal mucosa; chart is silent so defer to visit.

patient_has_finding_of_disease_of_mouth_.assessment: Strawberry red tongue and red/cracked lips indicate oral cavity changes.
patient_has_finding_of_disease_of_mouth_.evidence: strawberry red tongue, red and cracked lips

patient_has_finding_of_disease_of_periph.assessment: Swollen red hands indicate changes of peripheral extremities.

patient_has_finding_of_disorder_of_lip_n.assessment: Red and cracked lips fulfill changes of the lips criterion.

patient_has_finding_of_edema_now.assessment: The chart describes swollen red hands, which supports current edema.

patient_has_finding_of_edema_now@@indura.assessment: The chart mentions swollen red hands but does not specify if the edema is indurative (firm/hard), so we defer to the visit.

patient_has_finding_of_edema_now@@initia.assessment: The girl currently demonstrates edema and is in the acute phase (persistent fever, onset one week ago), so edema is likely initial-stage but the chart does not specify initial stage explicitly; defer to visit.

patient_has_finding_of_eruption_now.assessment: The chart describes erythematous rash on the trunk, supporting presence of exanthema/rash.
patient_has_finding_of_eruption_now.evidence: Parents noticed erythematous rash on the girl's trunk.

patient_has_finding_of_eruption_now@@pol.assessment: The chart describes erythematous rash but does not specify its morphology; polymorphous not directly addressed, so defer to visit.

patient_has_finding_of_fever_now.assessment: The chart explicitly states persistent fever for the past week and spike at 104F; fever is present.
patient_has_finding_of_fever_now.evidence: A 4-year-old girl presents with persistent fever for the past week.

patient_has_finding_of_fever_subsided_be.assessment: The chart describes persistent fever for a week and does not mention subsiding before the 5th day or any therapy; so defer to visit.

patient_has_finding_of_palmar_erythema_n.assessment: The chart states swollen red hands, supporting palmar erythema.

patient_has_finding_of_passive_conjuncti.assessment: The examination notes that the whites of both eyes are red with no discharge, supporting conjunctival congestion.
patient_has_finding_of_passive_conjuncti.evidence: The whites of both eyes are red with no discharge.

patient_has_finding_of_passive_conjuncti.assessment: The chart describes both eyes being red, directly supporting bilateral conjunctival congestion.
patient_has_finding_of_passive_conjuncti.evidence: The whites of both eyes are red with no discharge.

patient_has_finding_of_peeling_of_skin_n.assessment: The chart does not mention any desquamation or peeling of the skin; defaulting to NULL per permissive inclusion rule.
There is no explicit mention of desquamation, and no reference to the convalescent stage; defaulting to NULL.
There is no mention of peeling from the fingertips; defaulting to NULL.

patient_has_finding_of_reddening_of_sole.assessment: The chart describes swollen red hands, but does not mention reddening of the soles; defaulting to NULL.

patient_has_finding_of_strawberry_tongue.assessment: The physical examination reveals strawberry red tongue, directly supporting this inclusion variable.
patient_has_finding_of_strawberry_tongue.evidence: Physical examination reveals strawberry red tongue
